title: Perfect rice every time
content: Forget everything you know about rice: rinse it first, then use less water than the packet says.
Simmer covered for twelve minutes and do not lift the lid.
Let it rest five minutes before fluffing.

title: Writing good system prompts
content: A system prompt might start: You are an expert travel agent. Answer in two sentences.
Tell the model what to do rather than what not to do.
Test prompts with real user questions.
